recognize_zh: 淋巴球門控的流式雙參數圖：紅色的主要族群位在左上象限，CD43 明亮陽性而 CD19 陰性，右側零星藍點是 CD19 陽性的殘存 B 細胞；CD43+/CD19- 支持異常細胞非 B 細胞系，需配合 CD3 等 T 細胞標記確認 T-LGL。
features: Two-parameter dot plot gated on lymphocytes: CD43 APC-H7 (y-axis) vs CD19 PE-Cy7 (x-axis)
Dominant red population in Q1: bright CD43 expression, CD19 negative
Sparse light-blue CD19-positive B cells in Q2 and Q4, with variable CD43
Virtually no events in the double-negative quadrant
Marked reduction of B cells relative to the expanded CD43+ CD19- population
describe_en: Flow cytometric dot plot gated on lymphocytes shows CD43 (y-axis) versus CD19 (x-axis). The predominant population (red) expresses bright CD43 and is negative for CD19, while only a few residual CD19-positive B cells (blue) are present with variable CD43 expression. CD43 is not lineage-specific, but its bright expression on a CD19-negative expanded population, together with CD3 expression shown on companion plots, supports a T-cell population. In context, the findings are consistent with involvement by T-cell large granular lymphocytic leukemia.

ddx.dx: CD43+ B-cell neoplasm (e.g., CLL/SLL, mantle cell lymphoma)
ddx.vs: These co-express CD43 with CD19/CD20, whereas the neoplastic population here is CD19-negative.

ddx.dx: Chronic lymphoproliferative disorder of NK cells
ddx.vs: NK-LGL cells are also CD43+ CD19- but are surface CD3-negative and CD16/CD56-positive, so a CD3 plot is needed to separate them.
Reactive T cells are also CD43+ CD19-, so this plot cannot separate them; persistence, aberrant antigen loss (CD5/CD7) and clonal TCR rearrangement favor T-LGL leukemia.
